statement: A finalized dispute settled every clause of the proof it used on the chain: a payment is applied when its hash was revealed in time and is unpaid otherwise (DeltaTransformer applyPayment; before the deadline an unrevealed clause makes the finalize revert, so it waits), an unfilled swap clause is unfilled. So when an Entity hears a j_dispute_over that was finalized, no hold, no quote and no offer of that Account stands, and nothing is reserved for a swap: in the committed state and in the state a pending frame of the node would commit, so the ack of a frame the peer committed brings no hold back. A lock the node forwarded to that peer is a lock the peer gave up, so the paybook entry fails back toward its source by the existing path. A dispute a counter ended settled nothing, and the clauses stay. This slice dissolves as unpaid and claims nothing about a clause the chain paid because its hash was revealed on chain in time (the payee's on-chain reveal, S9b: such a hold must resolve, and the Entity has no reveal event to tell it so). Owed: S9b, the hub's upstream hold when its downstream lock resolves after the finalize, and the Depository's debts.
source: builder 10-02 (S9 dispute with an open HTLC, plan/s9-dispute-clause-design.md); DeltaTransformer.sol 289-308

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival page models frames within an epoch; what the Entity does with its holds when the chain finalizes is an Entity rule
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model has the chain's cells, not the Entity's ledger after a finalize
layers.contract: n/a: the contract settles the clauses; this row is what the Entity does with its own holds, and the e2e dispute-clause step reads both against the chain

killers.name: R-HOLD-DISSOLVE no hold, quote or offer and nothing reserved stand; money and limits are as they were
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE dissolving twice changes nothing, and an Account with no clause is as it was
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE a finalized dispute leaves no hold on either side, and the head is the same
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE a dispute that a counter ended settled nothing: the hold stays
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE a lock whose ack the link lost is dissolved in the frame in flight too
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE a lock forwarded to the peer is given up: the entry fails back toward its source
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE a Host that restarts after the finalize replays to the same Account
R-HOLD-DISSOLVE the hold's id is free again: a new lock under it is judged as on an empty Account
